description: Short weekly digest for a property: the last 7 synced days vs the 7 before (and year-over-year), top 3 queries/pages up and down, anomalies of the week, Google updates and annotations, quick wins, technical alerts (Core Web Vitals, indexing), AI search lines and three next actions. Computed live from the synced data; when the account's weekly report job has run, storedReport carries the saved report's KPIs and actions (the same the e-mail/Slack digest sent) and alerts lists the alerts raised in the week. endDate moves the week (default: last synced date). Use for "what changed this week", Monday stand-ups, a client's weekly update. / Resumo da semana com movers, anomalias, alertas e 3 ações.

brand.description: all (default); branded = only queries containing one of the property's branded_terms; non-branded = the rest. Needs branded terms set on the property in the Organiq panel, otherwise invalid_argument with the panel URL. / Marca × sem marca.

country.description: Country as ISO-3166-1 alpha-3, as in Search Console: bra, usa, prt, arg.

endDate.description: Last day of the week (default: last synced date).

pageContains.description: Only pages whose URL contains this text (case-insensitive), e.g. "/blog/".

query.description: Only queries containing this text, or a regex as /…/ (e.g. "/^how to/"; no flag = case-insensitive).

site.description: Property: displayName ("example.com"), Search Console siteUrl ("sc-domain:example.com", "https://www.example.com/") or numeric id. A unique substring among visible properties also works ("exam"). list_sites shows the options. The value "demo" selects a demonstration site with fictional data: it works without signing in and is read-only. / Propriedade por nome, siteUrl ou id; "demo" é um site de demonstração com dados fictícios, sem login e só leitura.

name: get_weekly_digest
title: Weekly digest
